name: machine-tricep-extension
instructions:
1. Setup in a seated position with your hands in a neutral grip on the handles.
2. Exhale and press the handles outward by extending the elbows.
3. Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Setup in a seated position with your hands in a neutral grip on the handles. 2. Exhale and press the handles outward by extending the elbows.
